game.label: Your own inFAMOUS from the PlayStation Store, NPUA80480 version 01.00, as RPCS3 installed it: its dev_hdd0/game/NPUA80480 folder (or RPCS3's data folder), with its licence (.rap) in RPCS3's exdata. RPCS3 and the PS3 firmware are needed too: they decrypt your copy. The disc release (BCUS98119) doesn't work yet.

prepare.label: Building the game for your Mac from your copy (the first time takes about 10 minutes and about 5 GB; macOS may ask once to install Apple's Command Line Tools)

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Full screen is macOS's own (its own Space). Borderless covers the screen without changing Spaces.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The size the game's window opens at.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: On waits for the screen's refresh: no tearing.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. 720p is the PS3's own; higher is sharper and needs a faster Mac. Experimental.

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.help: How the picture is fitted to the window. MetalFX is Apple's upscaler (macOS 13 or newer).

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: Smooths jagged edges. SMAA is sharper than FXAA and costs a little more.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Keeps streets and rooftops sharp at shallow angles.

settings.label: Adaptive triggers
settings.help: DualSense only: the trigger you fire bolts with clicks like a gun's and buzzes while you fire; the other has a light resistance.

settings.label: Button prompts
settings.help: The buttons the game shows. Automatic follows the controller in use.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The frame rate in the window's title.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your inFAMOUS save slots, as the game writes them (BCUS98119_INFAMOUS_...).

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: game.log (the last session) and install.log (the last setup).

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has built, so later sessions don't stutter. Clearing only helps if the picture looks wrong after an update.

exit_codes.40: Your copy isn't one this port reads: it needs your own inFAMOUS from the PlayStation Store (NPUA80480) as RPCS3 installed it, the dev_hdd0/game/NPUA80480 folder, with its licence (.rap) in RPCS3's exdata folder. The disc release (BCUS98119) doesn't work yet. Pick it again on the game's page.
exit_codes.41: Your Mac needs something first: Apple's Command Line Tools (their installer opened: finish it), the build tools (CMake and Python 3.10 or newer: the inFAMOUS launcher installs them with Homebrew), or RPCS3 with the PS3 firmware, which decrypts your copy. The setup's last lines say which. Then set the game up again.
exit_codes.42: Couldn't download what the build needs (the ps3recomp toolkit or its Python packages). Check the internet connection and set the game up again.
exit_codes.43: Building the game failed. Check there are about 5 GB free, then set it up again: it continues where it stopped. install.log in the logs folder says why.
exit_codes.44: inFAMOUS is already running, or another setup of it is. Close it or wait for it, then try again.
exit_codes.45: The game isn't built yet. Set it up again on the game's page (the first time takes about 10 minutes).
exit_codes.46: The inFAMOUS launcher couldn't start it. Open the launcher itself to see why.
